part2.question: Describe a quiet place that you would love to go to

segments.v: I want to talk about Mount Kōya in Japan. It is a quiet place in the mountains with many old temples. It is near Osaka. I knew this place from a travel video on YouTube. I watched it with my father. In the video, the place was very quiet and beautiful, with big trees and old stones. If I go there, I want to stay in a temple for one night. I want to eat vegetarian food and wake up early to see the monks pray. I also want to walk in the old forest. I want to go there with my father because he loves history. I want to go there because my city is very noisy and busy. I want to relax and feel peaceful. I also love Japan very much.
